problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign parcels to identical delivery trucks. Parcels:
* Parcel P: size 66 cubic feet
* Parcel Q: size 66 cubic feet
* Parcel R: size 43 cubic feet
* Parcel S: size 44 cubic feet
* Parcel T: size 35 cubic feet
* Parcel U: size 70 cubic feet
* Parcel V: size 62 cubic feet
* Parcel W: size 63 cubic feet
* Parcel X: size 56 cubic feet
* Parcel Y: size 62 cubic feet
* Parcel Z: size 49 cubic feet
* Parcel AA: size 37 cubic feet
* Parcel BB: size 39 cubic feet
* Parcel CC: size 57 cubic feet

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic feet. Assign all parcels using the fewest trucks. Every parcel must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total volume in any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
